title: executive-daily-priorities-cameron-2026-03-11
body:
Morning scratchpad — Cameron (11 Mar 2026)

Top 3 for today (high level)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity SLA language for sales deck. Need legal sign-off by EOD so GTM can cut a pilot contract. (Action: Maya to get redline from legal, target 5pm PST)
- Approve rollout plan for Private v2 (canary + auto-fallback). Confirm SRE & infra on rollback window and runbook. (Action: Jordan to confirm runbook status before 3pm)
- Customer escalations: ACME integration regression — ensure on-call/solutions engineering triage and communicate timeline to customer success. (Action: Priya to lead customer comms)

Meetings / prep notes
- 09:00 — Exec sync (15m): quick updates on Dedicated SLAs, Private v2 timeline, hiring ask for infra.
  - Ask: 2-week runway to finalize partner pricing for EMEA.
  - Slide prep: one slide with committed throughput, target latency, and pricing tiers.

- 10:30 — Infra deep dive (45m): kernel selection heuristics and quantization options from serving-runtime team.
  - Prep: Review Alex's memo (link in GH PR #2145). Questions: what are realistic latency gains on A100 vs H100 for 8-bit quant? Are there throughput regressions at seq len 2048?
  - Bring up: plan for measuring regressions in production using canary traffic (metric: 99p latency, token/sec, error rate).

- 13:00 — Customer QBR: ACME + solutions.
  - Key: reassure on timeline for fix, offer dedicated engineering hours for migration if needed.

- 15:30 — Legal + GTM: SLA wording and pilot contract.
  - Must confirm termination/cancellation language and data residency clause for private deployments.

Follow-ups & decisions to finalize
- SLA language: accept legal's redlines except Section 4.3 — need to preserve a clear latency SLO for reserved capacity customers.
- Private v2 rollout: approve canary with 2% traffic for 48h, then 10% for 24h, full rollout at 72h if health metrics OK. Confirm automatic rollback triggers.
- Pricing: authorized one-time pilot discount for customers < $10k/mo committed, but require 3-month minimum and dedicated onboarding fee.

Delegations / outstanding asks
- Maya: consolidate legal redlines and send final doc to me + GTM by 5pm.
- Jordan: finalize rollback runbook and add to the Private deployment runbook page. Leave a TODO with runbook owner and escalation matrix.
- Priya: draft customer comms for ACME QBR; include clear ETA and offer for engineering pair session.
- Alex (serving-runtime): provide benchmark table for quantization profiles (8-bit, 4-bit experimental) across representative models + seq len buckets by end of day.

Quick reminders / personal
- Block 4-5pm for follow-up email and contract review (do not let calendar get double-booked).
- Check in with People Ops on two executive-level hiring candidates (brief notes in candidate tracker).
- Prep talking points for Monday investor check-in: emphasize product-market fit in Dedicated & Private, early traction numbers (NPS, ARR from pilots).

Notes to self (loose)
- Revisit routing policy defaults — want latency-first for premium customers and cost-first for trial accounts. Add to backlog if not done.
- Look into adding a small “post-deploy smoke test” that runs model regression prompts (10 seeds) immediately after rollout to catch obvious quality regressions.

Slack quick pings to send
- @maya: legal redlines reminder + deadline 5pm
- @jordan: confirm runbook ownership & expected PR link
- @priya: ACME comms draft before QBR

Open questions
- Do we have capacity cushion for two simultaneous Private rollouts next week? (Infra says maybe; need exact numbers)
- Is there any regulatory blocker for our EMEA pilot customers regarding key management? Check with security/compliance.

Bottom line
- Focus today on SLAs + Private v2 rollout safety checks + calming ACME. If those 3 move forward, the rest of the week will breathe.

End of notes.
